criteria.title: Flag overdue invoices
criteria.startingState: As of 2026-01-02 UTC, overdue_unpaid and overdue_paid are due 2026-01-01, and due_today is due 2026-01-02. The fixture names specify payment state; due_today is unpaid.
actions: The reviewer opens the invoice queue.
Inspect the Overdue flag on all three fixture invoices.
criteria.expectedResult: Unpaid invoices past their due date show Overdue. Unpaid invoices due today and paid invoices have no Overdue flag.
